assertions.name: widest_band_counts_distinct_values
assertions.source: The 0.5% band — the widest one the verdict reports — holds as many distinct candidate values as labels, so the coincidence-basin count is not inflated by two names for one number.

assertions.name: match_bands_are_nested
assertions.source: 0.05% ⊆ 0.11% ⊆ 0.5% ⊆ all scored — the nesting the verdict's candidate counts are read off; a mis-typed threshold or a swapped list breaks it.

description: Categorical-uniqueness test for Option E v9's (1+q)/2 multiplicative correction. Tests whether the 0.11% match is uniquely identifying or one of several near-matches in a coincidence basin.

data.verdict: UNIQUE: only '(1 + q)/2' matches within 0.11%. This is structurally suggestive (though not yet a derivation).

candidate_label_value_collisions.meaning: labels in the curated candidate list that denote the same number; only matters if a colliding pair enters a band
